verdict.rationale: Token2 documents PIV support via Windows miniDriver for smartcard-based certificate enrollment/login with on-prem AD, and PIV configuration via the Companion App on macOS with a guide for PIV-based macOS login, indicating workstation sign-in support. However, evidence is thin on VPN integration and code signing use cases specifically, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of certificate-based login working end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit VPN client integration guidance, code-signing workflow documentation, and independent verification of PIV certificate login in practice.
